reuse.why: Takes its category set from the shared getCategoriesForBulkAction and writes via setBudget/batchMessages like the sibling actions, but re-reads sum-amount by hand rather than through an existing amount helper.

duplication.why: The per-category loop copies set3MonthAvg's body: the 'income and not tracking => skip' guard and the 'is_income === 0 => negate' sign flip are repeated again instead of being shared.

placement.why: The action lives in budget/actions.ts with the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Besides the new action and its tests, the diff reformats several unrelated existing tests in actions.test.ts.

maintainability.why: Consistent with existing actions and easy to read, though it adds one more copy of the income/sign rules that every month-wide action now repeats.
